mapper.insert: INSERT INTO herb_atlas ( species_id, atlas_code, image_url, image_name, image_type, growth_stage, medicinal_part, source, description, status, create_time, update_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{speciesId}, #{atlasCode}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageName}, #{imageType}, #{growthStage}, #{medicinalPart}, #{source}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE herb_atlas SET image_type = #{imageType}, growth_stage = #{growthStage}, medicinal_part = #{medicinalPart}, source = #{source}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT a.id, a.species_id, s.herb_name, a.atlas_code, a.image_url, a.image_name, a.image_type, a.growth_stage, a.medicinal_part, a.source, a.description, f.feature_vector, f.feature_dimension AS feature_dim, f.feature_version AS feature_model_version, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.deleted FROM herb_atlas a LEFT JOIN herb_species s ON s.id = a.species_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN herb_atlas_feature f ON f.atlas_id = a.id AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.extract_status = 'success' WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND f.feature_vector IS NOT NULL AND f.feature_vector != '' ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
